gloss: rectangular cut; cut into thin strips

definitions.gloss: rectangular cut; cut into thin rectangular strips
definitions.explanation: a cutting technique where ingredients are sliced into thin rectangular shapes resembling tanzaku (paper strips used for wishes)

examples.japanese: {大根|だいこん}を{短冊切|たんざくぎ}りにする。
examples.english: To cut the daikon into thin rectangles.

examples.japanese: {短冊切|たんざくぎ}りにした{豆腐|とうふ}を{味噌汁|みそしる}に{入|い}れる。
examples.english: Add the rectangular-cut tofu to the miso soup.

examples.japanese: {炒|いた}め{物|もの}には{短冊切|たんざくぎ}りが{適|てき}している。
examples.english: Rectangular cuts are suitable for stir-fries.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
Named after {短冊|たんざく}, the rectangular paper strips used for writing wishes during Tanabata festival.

TYPICAL SIZE:
About 4-5 cm long, 1 cm wide, 5 mm thick.
